# canary help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
Canary — portfolio, risk and order tools for Interactive Brokers
Runs locally. Every build previews orders; sending or changing one needs the
trading build, approval and safety checks.

Usage: canary <subcommand> [flags] [args]
Start: canary status — check the broker connection

Desk
Account, positions, orders and risk

  status          Check Canary and the broker connection
  account         Account value, buying power, cash, margin and daily P&L
  positions       List open stock, option, bill and bond positions
  strategies      View option strategies; close or reduce them as one order
  portfolio       Holdings by asset class and sector; review the next planned
                  action
  locks           Keep every held contract of a name out of bulk and automatic
                  reductions
  add             Plan a stock addition or opening and review it through
                  existing order confirmation
  stress          Check portfolio risks and the evidence behind them
  mandate         Check the book's loss measure against the mandate's loss room
  core            See the core sleeve's monthly target, its pending row and what
                  it would trade
  strategy        See a registered strategy's monthly target and what it would
                  trade, or replay its rule over past month-ends
  brief           Portfolio summary, urgent items first; more with --details
  edge            Review past trading decisions using broker records
  scorecard       Score past decisions per strategy, with the evidence and its
                  gates
  short-interest  Screen FINRA short positions across US equities
  lending         Read lending income, borrowing fees and stock market context
  rules           Check trading rules, biggest breaches first; set limits with
                  rules policy
  policy          Risk limits, capital and losses from the portfolio peak
  recon           Compare broker statements with recorded deposits and
                  withdrawals
  reporting       Check broker statement setup, performance, currency data and
                  execution costs
  proposals       Protection proposals to close or reduce positions
  opportunities   Option exercise opportunities
  trading         Check trading permissions and what blocks orders
  orders          View open orders and locally recorded order history
  order           Preview, place, change, cancel or check orders

Markets
Prices, signals and market calendars

  data            Check data availability and freshness
  market          Prices, history and daily market activity
  technical       Price trends, relative strength, volatility and trading volume
  watchlist       View and edit your saved watchlist
  setups          Review volume signals, find call options and check prices
                  after entry
  chains          Recorded daily option chains and their coverage
  calendar        Exchange hours, holidays and early closes
  macro           Economic calendar and official releases
  regime          Market conditions across eight indicators

System
Run, configure and update Canary

  settings        View settings and change supported preferences
  app             Run the paired mobile app
  mcp             Run Canary’s connection for AI assistants (MCP)
  daemon          Run the background broker connection (usually starts
                  automatically)
  setup           Set up an AI assistant, the mobile app or broker statements
  update          Install the latest Canary release
  restart         Restart Canary and any running mobile app server
  stop            Stop Canary and the mobile app server
  version         Print version, commit, build date

Run canary <command> --help for usage and available actions.
Run canary <command> <action> --help for that action's flags.
Add --json to data commands for output that scripts can read.

Colour: NO_COLOR=1 disables it; CANARY_COLOR=always|never overrides.
